scope: Independent source-only QA of M2015. Official and independent tests ran under CPython 3.6 and 3.12. All executable mutations were confined to TemporaryDirectory namespaces. No production process, remote endpoint, archive, shard or payload namespace, merge, reducer, GPU, or EDA tool was accessed.

p1.finding: M2015 correctly classifies an import-work directory containing result.json, SHA256SUMS, and a truncated SHA256SUMS.seal.sha256 as partial_unsealed. However, _promote_result_resumable then calls inherited Q.quarantine_partial_import_work. That helper re-runs Q.inspect_import_work_topology, observes all three allowed pathnames, calls the topology complete, and rejects with 'only incomplete normal import-work may be quarantined' before moving it. The independent TemporaryDirectory hammer invoked the real recovery function twice; both attempts failed, the orphan remained at the fixed import-work path, and no canonical target was published.
p1.impact: The exact M2013 ordinary crash boundary is not repaired. An interruption after all three names are created but before the outer seal is fully written permanently strands the only manual-resume path.
p1.required_repair: Create an additive successor with an M2015-local no-replace quarantine operation whose authorization predicate accepts every topology-safe partial_unsealed state, including all three regular allowed names with an invalid or truncated seal. It must preserve the orphan in a numbered no-overwrite quarantine, reverify immutable staging, make a fresh exclusive copy, verify it against the plan, and publish no-replace. Correctly sealed but plan-mismatching evidence must remain preserved and rejected. Add a regression that calls the full promotion function, not only classify_import_orphan.

p2.finding: The effective inherited P publication path and Q.quarantine helper are correctly rebound to M2015. Nevertheless, Q.PRESTOP, Q.ATTEMPT, Q.PLAN, Q.RESULT, Q.FAILURE, and Q.STAGING_PARENT retain M2012 paths even though the source comment says both nested modules are explicitly bound so they cannot silently publish into an old namespace.
p2.impact: The current exported M2015 runtime uses P and is fail-closed, so this did not produce a production mutation. The stale Q namespace is an audit and future-maintenance hazard if a Q runtime callable is later reused directly.
p2.required_repair: Either bind all runtime path constants in Q to M2015 and permanently assert M/Q/P equality, or narrow and document the inheritance so only the exact path-free Q helpers are reachable. Add a path-binding regression for every effective runtime callable.

single_next_action: Create one additively numbered source successor that directly no-replace-quarantines every topology-safe partial_unsealed import-work state (including three names with a truncated seal), keeps authenticated plan mismatch fail-closed, and closes or explicitly narrows the stale Q path namespace; then obtain a fresh independent source hammer before any process capture or release authoring.
